Subject: StellarNet vendor master: legal entity, remittance & PO routing

Hi Luis / StellarNet AP team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — glad we’re moving this across the finish line. To create your vendor master record and ensure invoices map to POs correctly, we need a few fields from you. I’ve attached our Supplier_Onboarding_Packet to make this quick. Please reply with the items below at your earliest convenience: 

Required for vendor record (minimum):
- Legal entity name (as registered with IRS / Companies House)
- Doing-business-as (DBA) if different
- Tax ID / EIN or VAT number
- Entity type (Corp / LLC / Partnership / Sole Prop) and jurisdiction of formation
- Registered legal address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Remittance address (if different from legal)
- AP contact name, email, and phone (primary)
- Preferred invoice delivery method (email, portal, EDI) and invoice email/endpoint
- Preferred currency and standard payment terms (e.g., Net 30)

If you will be paid by ACH/wire, please include a bank verification (bank letter or cancelled check) with account name, bank name, routing number, account number, and SWIFT (for wires). For US vendors we also need a completed W-9 (attached if helpful).

POs & invoice routing notes:
- Redwood requires a PO number on every invoice for goods/services that were procured via our system. If StellarNet will receive POs from us, confirm the invoice recipient and whether your AP team requires the PO printed on the invoice or transmitted via portal.
- If you cannot include PO numbers, please mark that in your reply and provide billing exception contact — we can discuss a temporary exception process, but it requires approvals from procurement and finance.

Attachments: Supplier_Onboarding_Packet.docx (form), vendor template with examples.

If you prefer, we can jump on a 15 min call to walk through the packet and confirm fields. Available today 3-4pm PT or tomorrow morning.

Thanks — I’ll loop Jonas and Marcus on next steps once we have the docs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Vendor Onboarding Specialist
Redwood Inference

Luis — thanks, received and that’s perfect. I’ve started the vendor master in our system with the details you provided and uploaded the two attachments to the vendor record. A couple of quick follow-ups so we can finish the ACH mapping and PO flow: 

1) Bank confirmation: we only need the last four digits to validate in our portal — you confirmed 4321 which matches. For our bank onboarding we’ll send a micro-deposit validation if your team opts for ACH; otherwise we’ll collect full wire details behind our secure intake.

2) PO routing: we will issue POs to invoices@stellarnet.com and expect the PO number printed on the invoice PDF. Jonas, can you confirm the PO creation cadence and whether we’ll include a Redwood vendor code on the PDF?

3) Vendor code & first PO: Jonas — please create vendor record RED-5201 in the procurement system and send an initial PO for the onboarding services (small dollar test PO). Luis — when you receive the PO, confirm the PO number is visible on your invoice and send a test invoice referencing the PO.

4) Remaining items: Certificate of Insurance and any additional compliance evidence — upload to the vendor record or reply here with PDFs.

I’ve created a short task for tracking: JIRA SUP-1294 and linked the internal onboarding page: https://redwood.example.com/internal/vendor-onboarding/5201

If you’re free, I can schedule a 15 min call tomorrow 10:00am PT to verify the PO + invoice match for your AP team.

Thanks again — moving quickly on our side.
